name: @etzhayyim/seibutsu-rw-free
description: RW-free reference implementation of seibutsu (生物 biodiversity taxonomy open-data: taxa + procedural traits + citizen-science observations) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces RW graph). GBIF/iNaturalist model — public reference; image→species identify (Murakumo inference) stays etzhayyim. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000.
